status: Explicit demonstration decisions. NOT supplied verbatim by the organizers and NOT approved real payroll rules.
versioningRule: Any change to this file bumps derivedPolicyVersion and appends a revisions entry. The effective rule version is identified by the SHA-256 of the rules source and of this file; version strings are labels.

revisions.semanticChanges: Initial derived policy: familyParticipationMode, allowanceInsurable, grossUpInsurable, contributionsExcludeVehicleBenefits, childAgeComparison; gross-up settings; display rounding; support limits.

Added occupation-ID mapping (decision R6, business-decisions.md section 5) and per-vehicle tax-key vehicle-type mapping for the 20 catalogue vehicles (SRC-03). Payroll policy flags, gross-up settings, display rounding and support limits unchanged.

policySources.familyParticipationMode: architecture.md §5 and §11; agent-spec.md T54/T55; supported by workbook E-002

supportLimits.source: architecture.md §6 (configurable demonstration support limits, not eligibility laws)

occupationIds.source: Decision R6 (business-decisions.md section 5): keyed by the exact trimmed Hebrew occupation name; never derived from row order; never reused. An unmapped workbook occupation, or a mapped occupation missing from the workbook, fails the import.

catalogueTaxKeys.source: SRC-03 (architecture.md §5 source inconsistency 2; agent-spec.md SRC-03): the catalogue omits the vehicle-type code. Each listed vehicle was individually verified to match a type-1 CSV record with the identical value of use and drive code. This is NOT a default for other vehicles: an unmapped catalogue vehicle fails the import.
